Messages.Author: Alexander Racher
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ!

I was following the recent discussion about melee weapons and aggro hand damage.
Although I think I know the answer I just wanted to ask you that:

Does a Vampire equipped with a Sengir Dagger inflict 3 aggravated hand damage with (e.g.) Undead Strenght? The card text reads that "Vampire with this equipment inflicts aggravated hand damage" (hope I remembered it right), whereas after your ruling melee weapons do melee damage and not hand damage.

Thanks a lot for clarification,

Xandl from C*A*R*D, Vienna, Austria
:-o

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Alexander Racher wrote:
> Hi LSJ!
>
> I was following the recent discussion about melee weapons and aggro
> hand damage.
> Although I think I know the answer I just wanted to ask you that:
>
> Does a Vampire equipped with a Sengir Dagger inflict 3 aggravated hand
> damage with (e.g.) Undead Strenght? The card text reads that "Vampire
> with this equipment inflicts aggravated hand damage" (hope I
> remembered it right), whereas after your ruling melee weapons do melee
> damage and not hand damage.

Allow me to offer a parallel explanation for Bastard Sword for
clarity's sake.

Sengir Dagger inflicts hand damage (as a strike).
Bastard Sword inflicts hand damage +1 (as a strike).

Sengir's damage (melee weapon damage) is aggravated.
Bastard Sword's damage (melee weapon damage) is not.

When using Undead Strength to strike with a Sengir Dagger at +2 damage,
the dagger inflicts hand damage +2. This damage (melee weapon damage)
is aggravated.

When using Undead Strength to strike with a Bastard Sword at +2 damage,
the sword inflicts hand damage +3. This damage (melee weapon damage)
is not aggravated.
